text:
sam: Quick: Nimbus private-offer pricing - CEO asked for a clean listing. Proposal: committed spend tiers (50k -> 5% off, 200k -> 12% off, 500k -> 20% off) + 6-month early-renew credit of 7% if renewed before term end. Thoughts?
lina: Love tiers. Two notes: (1) need clear expiry language for early-renew credit (e.g., must renew within 60 days before term end) (2) SI enablement must be queued before public listing so field doesn't oversell.
mike: From billing/ops: prefer credits applied as billing adjustments tagged `credit:early_renew` and `offer:nimbus-pvt`. Avoid creating new SKUs. Also add reconciliation cap to limit exposure.
sam: Agree cap = min(7% of ARR, $50k). Legal to draft T&Cs with anti-gaming clause.
ops-bot: Checklist: marketplace copy, SI playbook, billing metadata, legal clause.
lina: I'll draft listing language: "Tiered committed discounts + one-time renewal credit for early conversion". Keep it consumer-friendly.
mike: I'll draft billing event sample and open PR: {event_type: credit_adjust, customer, offer, tag, amount_usd, cap_usd}.
sam: Great. Action items: Lina copy + SI checklist, Mike billing PR + cap, Sam loop in legal. If all green, publish listing next Thursday.
ops-bot: Event scheduled: Nimbus private-offer review  1787655000.
